title: inference-api/latency@1 context
description: Validates the projection { <context key>: value } of a run's ContextProfile (non-null values only). The keys listed in `required` are the protocol's required context: a run whose profile carries any of them as null/unknown is `excluded`, not defaulted (ADR-0003).

model.requested.description: Model identifier the operator asked the endpoint for

model.reported.description: Model identifier the endpoint reported in its responses (origin: measured)

concurrency.description: Concurrent in-flight requests during the run (this harness: always 1)

cache_disabled.description: Whether provider-side prompt/response caching was disabled for the run

client_region.description: Where the client ran, as an operator-chosen label (e.g. a cloud region or `local`)

prompt_set.description: Identifier of the fixed prompt set the harness used
